confidence_notes: Beer, coffee and meal anchors are medium: several Taiwan city price points and some Kenting and Hengchun guide figures, several of them dated 2023 or undated, adjusted for a beach-resort premium and price drift. Cocktail and wine_glass are low: no Kenting-specific cocktail or per-glass wine prices were found, so they are set from the beer anchor using typical Taiwan bar price relationships and sanity-checked against Taipei cocktail prices of roughly NT$350-500. All four accommodation anchors are low-confidence holistic estimates for July peak season, with no listing or booking-page check. Prices are as listed and may exclude the 10 percent service charge. FX is the 18 Nov 2026 AUD/USD value on the RBA exchange-rates page; the F11.1 table itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: No direct Kenting price index was found. Food and drink anchors use Taiwan city price points (Taipei, Taichung, Kaohsiung and national averages) plus Kenting and Hengchun guide figures, with a beach-resort premium. Accommodation is benchmarked to Taiwan's southern beach-resort towns in July peak season from general knowledge; no accommodation search was run.
